subject.title: RFC: Org claim disputes and account recovery

question: Which evidence and identity-continuity rules should authorize namespace transfer, reservation, aliasing, or account and publisher recovery when ownership is disputed or the prior owner is deleted or inactive?
rationale: Source inspection can confirm the current safeguards, but it cannot choose the permanent authorization criteria, abuse tradeoffs, or which sensitive checks may be promised publicly.

options.title: Approve Explicit Policy
options.body: Define stable public evidence categories and decision principles while keeping sensitive verification details and exceptional operations in a private staff runbook.

options.title: Retain Discretionary Review
options.body: Document transfers and deleted-owner recovery as case-by-case staff judgments without fixed public thresholds.

options.title: Split Recovery Policy
options.body: Finalize account and publisher recovery guarantees separately while retaining namespace-dispute adjudication in this RFC.

recommendation.title: Approve Explicit Policy
recommendation.body: Define stable public evidence categories and decision principles while keeping sensitive verification details and exceptional operations in a private staff runbook.

likelyOwner.reason: His RFC authorship, merged claim-intake work, related-report coordination, and current ownership routing provide the strongest available connection to the cross-cutting decision.
